images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 24 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light warm ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 76 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a plain black fine-gauge wool crew neck sweater folded neatly, a slim silver wristwatch with a black leather strap, relaxed loose-fit light heather grey wide trousers with a soft drape, a pair of chocolate brown suede loafers. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items: the plain black crew neck sweater untucked, the silver watch on his left wrist, the loose light grey wide trousers, the chocolate brown suede loafers, walking slowly with one hand relaxed, on a quiet Seoul Seochon side street with a cafe window and warm brick wall, soft golden hour late autumn light, only in the lower 76 percent, headless body-only framing cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic knit and suede textures, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks.
